p: eleventh year: Either of the captivity of Jeconiah or of the reign of Zedekiah.
gates of the people: That is, the famous city Jerusalem to which all people resorted.
replenished: My riches and fame will increase: thus the wicked rejoice at their fall by whom they may have any profit or advantage.
daughters who are in the field: The towns that belonged to her.
garrisons shall go down to the: For Tyre was built by art and by labour of men was won out of the sea. Some refer this to the image of the noble men which they had erected for their glory and renown.
thou shalt be a place to: I will make you so bare that you will have nothing to cover you.

sea shall come down from their: The governors and rulers of other countries that dwell by the sea: by which he signifies that her destruction would be so horrible that all the world would hear of it and be afraid.
by seafaring men: Meaning, merchants who by their traffic enriched her wonderfully and increased her power.
living: Meaning in Judea when it will be restored.
